newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - BUDGET REVENUE 86.29 MLN LITAS SHORT IN 1Q.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - BUDGET REVENUE 86.29 MLN LITAS SHORT IN 1Q.

text.p: Lithuania's state budget revenue was 86.29 million litas below target in the first quarter of 1997, the finance ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said in a statement that it had planned to collect 1.262 billion litas in the first three months of the year but collected 1.176 billion litas.
It said that it plans to collect 6.019 billion litas for the entire fiscal year.
The VAT was the major source of income, netting 628.7 million litas.
The government has vowed to improve revenue collection and crack down on tax evasion, which is considered to be rife.
